summary: CervoMed Inc. filed an 8-K to report a registered direct offering of 2,500,000 shares of common stock at $4.00 per share, for aggregate gross proceeds of $10 million, with H.C. Wainwright acting as placement agent. The offering is expected to close on June 22, 2026. This is a routine at-the-market or direct equity financing, not a special situation. No premium, control change, or restructuring is involved. Proceeds are for working capital. There is no risk-arb angle; it is a standard capital raise under an effective S-3 shelf.
